**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reset queue gauges when statuses disappear**

When the last event for a status is processed, `EventsRepo.getQueueMetrics()` returns no row for that status because it groups only rows that still exist, and this loop only updates statuses present in that result. After a scrape has seen `aiops_events_queue_depth{status="queued"} 10`, draining the queue leaves that gauge at 10 indefinitely, so the documented queue-depth/oldest-age SLO alerts can fire on stale data until another event with the same status appears.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bootstrap telemetry before loading instrumented modules**

This starts the OpenTelemetry SDK inside `main()`, but `index.ts` has already statically imported modules such as `createPool` (which imports `pg`) and `@hono/node-server` before `main()` can run. For auto-instrumentations that patch libraries as they are loaded, enabling the SDK this late means configuring `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*` can still miss traces from those preloaded server/DB modules; move the telemetry bootstrap to a preload/entry module before importing the application graph, or dynamically import the rest of the server after `startTelemetry()`.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
